meta.name: add-teams
meta.description: Add Microsoft Teams channel integration via Chat SDK.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 集成 Microsoft Teams 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Teams 消息通知功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Microsoft Teams channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Teams messaging to your application

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把 Teams 渠道适配器复制进项目、注册它并安装固定版本依赖;若 .env 还没有 Teams 凭据,它会引导你提供公网 URL 和机器人名、登录 Microsoft 365,然后创建机器人、写入凭据并返回 Teams 安装链接。
howto.when: 当你说要给项目添加 Microsoft Teams 支持或 Teams 聊天功能时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 Microsoft Teams 接到这个项目里。
say.note: Claude 会复制 Teams 适配器并开始配置向导。

say.text: 添加 Teams 机器人,名字叫内部小助手。
say.note: 会先询问公网 URL,再创建机器人并返回安装链接。

say.text: 我想让这个助手直接给我的 Teams 账号发私信。
say.note: 会确认账号归属并把机器人绑定到你的 Teams 私聊。

howto.what_en: Copies Teams adapter into project, registers it, installs pinned dependency, then runs setup: if none configured, prompts for public URL and bot name, signs into M365, creates bot, stores .env credentials, returns install link.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add Microsoft Teams support or Teams chat integration to the project.

say_en.text: Add Microsoft Teams support to this project.
say_en.note: Claude copies the adapter and starts the guided setup.

say_en.text: Add a Teams bot named Internal Assistant.
say_en.note: Asks for public URL, creates bot, returns install link.

say_en.text: I want this assistant to DM my Teams account directly.
say_en.note: Confirms owner and links bot to your Teams 1:1 chat.
